tasks.label: Analysis coverage summary
tasks.command: pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/analysis test:coverage && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='packages/analysis/coverage/coverage-final.json';const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));const pct=(c,t)=>t?100*c/t:100;const sumc=o=>{if(!o)return[0,0];if(Array.isArray(o)){let tot=0,cov=0;for(const e of o){if(Array.isArray(e)){for(const n of e){tot++;if(n>0)cov++;}}else{tot++;if(e>0)cov++;}}return[cov,tot];}const keys=Object.keys(o);let cov=0;for(const k of keys)if(o[k]>0)cov++;return[cov,keys.length];};let totS=[0,0],totB=[0,0],totF=[0,0],totL=[0,0];const rows=[];for(const [fn,c] of Object.entries(d)){const [sC,sT]=sumc(c.s);const [bC,bT]=sumc(c.b);const [fC,fT]=sumc(c.f);const [lC,lT]=sumc(c.l);totS[0]+=sC;totS[1]+=sT;totB[0]+=bC;totB[1]+=bT;totF[0]+=fC;totF[1]+=fT;totL[0]+=lC;totL[1]+=lT;rows.push([pct(sC,sT),sT,pct(bC,bT),pct(fC,fT),pct(lC,lT),fn]);}rows.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]||b[1]-a[1]);console.log('packages/analysis coverage totals (from coverage-final.json):');console.log(`- statements: ${pct(totS[0],totS[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totS[0]}/${totS[1]})`);console.log(`- branches:   ${pct(totB[0],totB[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totB[0]}/${totB[1]})`);console.log(`- functions:  ${pct(totF[0],totF[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totF[0]}/${totF[1]})`);console.log(`- lines:      ${pct(totL[0],totL[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totL[0]}/${totL[1]})`);console.log('\nLowest statement coverage files (min 20 statements):');let shown=0;for(const r of rows){if(r[1]<20)continue;const rel=r[5].includes('/packages/analysis/')?r[5].split('/packages/analysis/')[1]:r[5];console.log(`- ${r[0].toFixed(2)}% s | ${r[2].toFixed(2)}% b | ${r[3].toFixed(2)}% f | ${r[4].toFixed(2)}% l | s=${r[1]} | ${rel}`);if(++shown>=12)break;}"

';out+=`- statements: ${pct(totS[0],totS[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totS[0]}/${totS[1]})
`;out+=`- branches:   ${pct(totB[0],totB[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totB[0]}/${totB[1]})
`;out+=`- functions:  ${pct(totF[0],totF[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totF[0]}/${totF[1]})
`;out+=`- lines:      ${pct(totL[0],totL[1]).toFixed(2)}% (${totL[0]}/${totL[1]})

`;out+='Lowest statement coverage files (min 20 statements):
';let shown=0;for(const r of rows){if(r[1]<20)continue;const rel=r[5].includes('/packages/analysis/')?r[5].split('/packages/analysis/')[1]:r[5];out+=`- ${r[0].toFixed(2)}% s | ${r[2].toFixed(2)}% b | ${r[3].toFixed(2)}% f | ${r[4].toFixed(2)}% l | s=${r[1]} | ${rel}
`;if(++shown>=20)break;}fs.writeFileSync('tmp/analysis-coverage-summary.txt',out);" && echo "WROTE tmp/analysis-coverage-summary.txt"
